early.name: Monster Rounds
early.annotation: If you struggle with killing minions before they shove into your tower or need to farm jungle, get this item. Also get this if you want to upgrade to Cultist Sacrifice

mid.name: Healbane
mid.annotation: Core – Good anti heal and huge impact on team fight with your ultimate

mid.name: Spirit Shredder

mid.name: Superior Duration

late.name: Indomitable
late.annotation: Very similar use case to Unstop, but mainly if one guy is jumping you instead of mass CC.

late.name: Unstoppable
late.annotation: Activate this BEFORE using your ultimate to prevent it from being interrupted

late.name: Boundless Spirit
late.annotation: Core – Once you complete this item and Escalating Exposure, your ultimate will start having a massive impact

late.name: Lightning Scroll
late.annotation: This item stuns them inside your ult, not only helping you but the team. Just overall a great item for Seven.
